unreplicated_claims.claim: Telomere attrition can serve as an objective cumulative welfare indicator integrating lifetime positive and negative experience in laboratory animals.
No study has empirically linked work-related stress / compassion fatigue among laboratory-animal personnel to measurable research quality, despite the claim being widely repeated.
A software-based Animal Welfare Assessment Grid (AWAG) can quantify an animal's lifetime cumulative welfare experience across species including macaques.

Microphysiological systems / organ-on-chip models, despite generating over a thousand publications per year, have not yet been widely adopted by the pharmaceutical industry or accepted in regulated drug-authorization processes as animal replacements.

evidence_gaps.what_is_missing: Prospective validation that project-level HBA reliably predicts realised benefit; almost all evidence is retrospective or theoretical.
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: HBA is the legal cornerstone of animal-research regulation, yet its objectivity and predictive validity remain largely untested.

evidence_gaps.topic: Culture of care and research quality
evidence_gaps.what_is_missing: Primary experimental demonstration that culture-of-care programmes or staff wellbeing improve animal welfare or data quality.
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Culture of care is being written into policy and frameworks on the assumption of a wellbeing-to-quality link that has not been measured (false_consensus_risk).

evidence_gaps.what_is_missing: Longitudinal, species-general objective biomarkers of cumulative lifetime harm; current evidence is single-species and often contradictory (e.g. NHP blood markers show no cumulative effect while telomere models predict one).
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Directive 2010/63/EU requires assessment of cumulative severity but validated cross-species tools are lacking.

evidence_gaps.what_is_missing: Evidence that commonly used analgesics (e.g. buprenorphine, meloxicam) actually prevent pain rather than merely being administered; controlled studies show failure to prevent pain or drug-induced harm reaching humane endpoints.
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Refinement is assumed to reduce suffering, but if standard analgesia is ineffective or harmful the welfare side of the harm-benefit analysis is overstated.

evidence_gaps.what_is_missing: Evidence that validated New Approach Methodologies (organ-on-chip, spheroids, organoids) are actually adopted by industry and accepted by regulators at scale, rather than demonstrated only in proof-of-concept papers.
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Replacement is the highest priority of the 3Rs, but a 'regulatory acceptance dilemma' and qualification/communication gaps mean technical feasibility has not translated into reduced animal use.

strongest_evidence.claim: Conventional laboratory housing significantly worsens stress-sensitive disease and mortality in rodents relative to enriched housing, with medium-to-large effect sizes.
strongest_evidence.why_strong: Pre-registered random-effects meta-analysis of 214 studies and 6495 animals with quantified effect sizes and confidence intervals, and an explicit test showing enrichment did not inflate data variability.

weakest_evidence_cited.claim: A 15-year NHP blood-marker dataset shows mildly-severe neuroscience procedures cause no long-term cumulative harm.
weakest_evidence_cited.why_weak: Single-laboratory, single-species observational dataset (39 macaques) with no untreated longitudinal control group; a null result that cannot exclude cumulative effects on unmeasured welfare dimensions.

papers.metric: DRF experiments presenting a power/sample-size calculation
papers.value_source_sentence: Even though all the experiments were reported as approved by animal research review committees, such as an Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee, which typically require justification for animal numbers in an experiment, no power or sample size calculation was presented for any of the 28 DRF experiments.
papers.experimental_conditions: literature review of DRF studies 2000-2013 plus updates

papers.value_source_sentence: Thirteen percent of studies (n = 27) failed to report use of anaesthesia and 97% (n = 206) did not report analgesia use.

figure_data.what_it_reveals: Across independent audits, formal Reduction (sample-size/power calculation) and Refinement (analgesia) are reported in only a small minority of animal studies, indicating systemic under-implementation of the 3Rs in the published record.

caveats: Different metrics (sample-size calc vs analgesia reporting) and different fields (critical care, radiation countermeasures, six intervention areas); all are reporting-compliance percentages but not the same denominator or the same 3R.

papers.metric: reduction in mice per experiment via refined pulmonary-embolism model
papers.value_source_sentence: Not only were they successful in strengthening the model by broadening the spectrum beyond a single extreme (i.e. fatal pulmonary embolism) and measuring a specific biological response rather than events with non-specific causes, but also they were able to reduce the number of mice per experiment by around 90% ().

papers.value_source_sentence: We show that, under our simulation conditions, the number of current control subjects can be reduced by more than half by including historical controls in the analyses.

figure_data.what_it_reveals: Independent methodological approaches (power-based sample sizing, model refinement, historical controls) each report roughly halving-to-90% reductions in animal numbers, quantifying the practical headroom for the Reduction principle.

caveats: Reductions are relative to different baselines (whole experiment vs control group only) and via different mechanisms; percentages are not directly additive.

papers.value_source_sentence: Messages highlighting ethical oversight and mutual benefits for humans and animals increased acceptance (from 44% to 55%) and reduced strong opposition (from 50% to 35%).

papers.value_source_sentence: Asked about their expectations of translation to humans (of toxicity, carcinogenicity, teratogenicity and treatment findings), most expect translation more than 60% of the time.

figure_data.what_it_reveals: Across surveys, public support for animal research is conditional and ambivalent, sensitive to messaging and species, and premised on expectations of high quality and human translation that exceed what the field achieves.

caveats: Metrics are different constructs (7-point support score, percent acceptance, expected translation rate) and should not be plotted on a single shared axis.

papers.experimental_conditions: baseline of a longitudinal resiliency trial

figure_data.what_it_reveals: A growing empirical literature (hundreds to ~1000 personnel per survey across the USA, Canada and Europe) documents compassion fatigue and psychological strain in laboratory-animal staff, giving the 'culture of care' debate a quantitative base even though none links staff wellbeing to research quality.

caveats: Surveys span different countries (USA, USA/Canada, German-speaking Europe) and years (2020-2023); one (JAALAS-21-000030) was conducted during the COVID-19 pandemic which may inflate reported strain; instruments differ (ProQOL vs GHQ-12/COPSOQ).
